title: cassine pubescens
intro: Cassine pubescens, commonly known as Cassina, is a plant species native to tropical Africa. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include treating various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The health benefits of Cassine pubescens include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Cassine pubescens include alkaloids, flavonoids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
